900.2.10(125).explanation: Exception R 125 brings in exception 900.2.10(7), removes the base maximum FSI, and sets its own rules: 12.0 m height for duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes and apartment buildings; 3 storeys for houses and townhouses and 4 storeys for multiplexes and apartment buildings; 17.0 m building depth; a 1.8 m side yard for buildings over 9 m tall; at most 20 units in an apartment building with at least 25% family-sized units; and a minimum FSI of 0.8 (existing buildings keep their lawful FSI). Two former by-laws still govern specific addresses on Avenue Road and Burnaby Boulevard.

900.2.10(745).explanation: Exception R 745 adds no site-specific rules; instead several former City of Toronto by-laws and sections of By-law 438-86 continue to govern these lands, some only at named addresses on Alcorn, Walker, Birch and Gange Avenues. MaxBLD does not evaluate those former by-laws.

900.2.10(471).explanation: Exception R 471 adds no site-specific rules; Section 12(1) 251 of former City of Toronto By-law 438-86 continues to govern these lands. MaxBLD does not evaluate that former by-law.

900.2.10(2).explanation: Exception R 2 adds no site-specific rules; Section 12(2) 325 of former City of Toronto By-law 438-86 and City of Toronto by-law 191-2001 (OMB) continue to govern these lands. MaxBLD does not evaluate those by-laws.
